I got the two failures. 700 tests ran and 698 passed — only these two failed, both in `auth/tokens.test.js`:

1. `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` (line 400)
2. `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` (line 650)

Worth a look before the next release — the first one sounds like it could let a revoked token still work.
